description: Request a reload of Memset’s DNS infrastructure, and optionally poll until it finishes.

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: The API key obtained from the Memset control panel.

parameters.name: poll
parameters.description: If true, it polls the reload job’s status and return when the job has completed (unless the 30 second timeout is reached first). If the timeout is reached then the task does not return as failed, but stderr indicates that the polling failed. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Submit DNS reload and poll
  community.general.memset_dns_reload:
    api_key: 5eb86c9196ab03919abcf03857163741
    poll: true
  delegate_to: localhost

return_values.name: memset_api
return_values.description: Raw response from the Memset API. Returned: always

return_values.name: error
return_values.description: Whether the job ended in error state. Returned: always Sample: true

return_values.name: finished
return_values.description: Whether the job completed before the result was returned. Returned: always Sample: true
